title: Bayesian optimization identifies active non-noble oxygen-evolution oxides
summary: Multiobjective Bayesian optimization guided robotic synthesis and electrochemical testing in a researcher-defined Co–Mn–Sb–Sn–Ti oxide space. The study identifies Mn-rich candidates and reports improved activity after Ti incorporation into MnOx following short accelerated-stress testing. Its 17-fold acceleration compares measurement time with a hypothetical exhaustive triplicated grid; it does not establish commercial electrolyzer lifetime or universal superiority.
